GenAiFunction.description: Summarizes Revenue Operations Intelligence account health for one selected Salesforce Account using approved Account, Opportunity, Case, Activity, Services, Finance, and usage signals. Use this only when the user asked about a single Account directly or when the planner already has a topAccountId from a prior directory or portfolio result. Do not use this action first for portfolio-wide or plural requests about multiple accounts. The analysis decides the scores and next-best-action guidance.
